_descriptions.dt: Simulation time step in seconds. Smaller values give finer integration but slower simulation.
_descriptions.max_steps: Maximum number of environment steps before an episode ends.
_descriptions.world_limit: Position boundary used to detect leaving the world. Very large values effectively disable the boundary.
_descriptions.terminate_on_world_limit: If true, terminate the episode when a drone exits world_limit.
_descriptions.min_separation: Capture distance in meters. If red and blue are closer than this, blue is caught.
_descriptions.desired_follow_distance: Preferred red pursuer following distance in meters. Red speed increases when separation is above this value.
_descriptions.start_sep_min: Minimum initial horizontal separation between red and blue in meters.
_descriptions.start_sep_max: Maximum initial horizontal separation between red and blue in meters.
_descriptions.u_trim: Blue evader trim forward speed in meters per second.
_descriptions.u_cmd_span: Speed command range around u_trim used by non-surface control modes.
_descriptions.theta_cmd_max: Maximum blue evader pitch angle command/state limit in radians.
_descriptions.phi_cmd_max: Maximum blue evader bank angle command/state limit in radians.
_descriptions.control_mode: Blue evader control interface. In surface mode, actions directly command elevator, throttle, and aileron.
_descriptions.action_tau: Low-pass smoothing time constant for blue evader RL actions. Larger values make action commands smoother and slower.
_descriptions.action_change_penalty: Reward penalty weight for abrupt blue evader action changes.
_descriptions.body_rate_penalty: Reward penalty weight for blue evader body rates, used to discourage shaking/oscillation.
_descriptions.delta_cmd_span: Blue evader action-to-command span for [elevator, throttle, aileron] in surface mode.
_descriptions.act_tau: Blue evader actuator lag time constant. Larger values make control surfaces respond more slowly and smoothly.
_descriptions.delta_rate_limit: Blue evader actuator rate limits per second for [elevator, throttle, aileron, rudder]. This limits how fast each command can change.
_descriptions.delta_trim: Blue evader trim actuator values for [elevator, throttle, aileron, rudder].
_descriptions.delta_min: Blue evader minimum actuator values for [elevator, throttle, aileron, rudder].
_descriptions.delta_max: Blue evader maximum actuator values for [elevator, throttle, aileron, rudder].
_descriptions.A_lon: Blue evader longitudinal dynamics matrix for states [u, w, q, theta].
_descriptions.B_lon: Blue evader longitudinal control matrix for inputs [elevator, throttle].
_descriptions.A_lat: Blue evader lateral-directional dynamics matrix for states [v, p, r, phi, psi].
_descriptions.B_lat: Blue evader lateral-directional control matrix for inputs [aileron, rudder].
_descriptions.K_lon: Legacy longitudinal feedback gain matrix used by non-surface control modes.
_descriptions.K_lat: Legacy lateral feedback gain matrix used by non-surface control modes.
_descriptions.x_lon_trim: Blue evader trim longitudinal state [u, w, q, theta].
_descriptions.x_lat_trim: Blue evader trim lateral state [v, p, r, phi, psi].
_descriptions.x_lon_min: Minimum blue evader longitudinal state limits [u, w, q, theta].
_descriptions.x_lon_max: Maximum blue evader longitudinal state limits [u, w, q, theta].
_descriptions.x_lat_min: Minimum blue evader lateral state limits [v, p, r, phi, psi].
_descriptions.x_lat_max: Maximum blue evader lateral state limits [v, p, r, phi, psi].
_descriptions.ref_turn_rate: Legacy red reference turn-rate value retained for compatibility.
_descriptions.ref_speed: Base red kamikaze horizontal pursuit speed command in meters per second.
_descriptions.ref_climb_amp: Legacy red climb oscillation amplitude retained for compatibility.
_descriptions.ref_climb_freq: Legacy red climb oscillation frequency retained for compatibility.
_descriptions.ref_max_turn_rate: Maximum red commanded yaw-rate in radians per second.
_descriptions.ref_max_climb_rate: Maximum red commanded vertical speed in meters per second.
_descriptions.ref_lead_time: Prediction time in seconds used to aim ahead of the blue evader.
_descriptions.ref_lead_blend: Blend between pure pursuit and lead pursuit. Zero aims directly at blue; larger values aim more ahead of blue.
_descriptions.ref_heading_gain: Gain converting red line-of-sight heading error into yaw-rate command.
_descriptions.ref_dyn_substeps: Number of internal red quadcopter dynamics integration substeps per environment step.
_descriptions.ref_speed_min: Minimum red commanded horizontal speed in meters per second.
_descriptions.ref_speed_max: Maximum red commanded horizontal speed in meters per second.
_descriptions.ref_speed_gain: Gain that increases red speed command as separation grows beyond desired_follow_distance.
_descriptions.gravity: Gravity acceleration in meters per second squared.
_descriptions.ref_mass: Red kamikaze quadcopter mass in kilograms.
_descriptions.ref_inertia: Red kamikaze body inertia [Ixx, Iyy, Izz] in kg*m^2.
_descriptions.ref_arm_length: Red kamikaze quadcopter arm length in meters.
_descriptions.ref_yaw_moment_coeff: Rotor yaw moment coefficient used by the red quadcopter mixer.
_descriptions.ref_motor_tau: Red motor thrust lag time constant in seconds. Smaller values make motors respond faster.
_descriptions.ref_max_rotor_thrust: Maximum thrust per red rotor in newtons.
_descriptions.ref_linear_drag: Linear aerodynamic drag coefficient for the red drone.
_descriptions.ref_quadratic_drag: Quadratic aerodynamic drag coefficient for the red drone.
_descriptions.ref_velocity_gain: Gain converting red velocity tracking error into acceleration command.
_descriptions.ref_max_accel: Maximum red commanded acceleration magnitude in meters per second squared.
_descriptions.ref_max_tilt: Maximum red commanded roll/pitch tilt angle in radians.
_descriptions.ref_attitude_kp: Red attitude proportional gains for [roll, pitch, yaw].
_descriptions.ref_attitude_kd: Red attitude damping gains for [roll, pitch, yaw]. Larger values reduce overshoot and instability.
_descriptions.ref_max_torque: Maximum red body torque command for [roll, pitch, yaw] in newton-meters.
